name: Dan Posle
description: Jutro posle festivala na Guncati imanju — 12 sati, 4 resursa, 32 micro-odluka. Zatvoriš dan ili gradiš zajednicu.

modules.src/main.js: Entry point — boot, game loop, option handling, hour advance, ending
modules.src/config.js: Konstante: HOURS, RESOURCES, ATMOSPHERE boje, AUDIO_CONFIG, ENDINGS, ACHIEVEMENTS_DEF
modules.src/state.js: Game state shape, createInitialState, save/load localStorage, computeCS
modules.src/atmosphere.js: Atmosfera po satu: setAtmosphere, iOS instant swap, text boja
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API — 13 ambijenata po satu, SFX (click/gain/loss/ending/achievement)
modules.src/render.js: DOM rendering: renderDecisionCard, renderHUD, flashResourceBars, renderChoiceResult
modules.src/ui.js: UI management: showIntroScreen, showEndingScreen, updateHUD, showHourTransition, toasts
modules.src/entities/characters.js: Toma NPC status, tomaStatus, CHARACTERS mapa
modules.src/entities/event_aftermath.js: Aftermath opis imanja po satu/neredu, neredIcons
modules.src/content/decisions.js: 32 decision noda sa deltama (E/V/S/N), prestige nodovi N9B/N26B
modules.src/content/characters_data.js: Toma, Slavko, Ana, Novinarka opisi, endingCharacterSummary
modules.styles/base.css: CSS token sistem, tipografija (Playfair+Source Serif+DM Mono), layout, dark mode
modules.styles/ui.css: HUD bars, decision cards, option buttons, ending screen, notifikacije, animations
modules.styles/atmosphere.css: Vizuelni indikatori sata, sun-arc, hour-dot-track, dnevna svetlost
modules.styles/theme.css: Guncati/Kluboslavija brand paleta, aforizam-card, score-card, toma-accent
